If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. Members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session are subject to late cancellation terms, which means you may not get a refund or credit. It is recommended to cancel as early as possible to allow others to book the court.

Baseline Padel has a policy called "Child Supervision and Drop-Off" that applies to all branches. It ensures that responsibility for a child's welfare is always clearly defined between the parent or guardian and the club staff, with no ambiguous handover periods during which nobody is accountable for a minor's whereabouts.

This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old unattended at the club while you play. The club requires that children under a certain age be supervised and not left alone.
